collection.title: Suzuki Grand Vitara 1998 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Suzuki Grand Vitara 1998 to 2004 will fit, this model requires a 19" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Grand Vitara which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
